thread:
alice: Quick heads-up — planning to flip the autoscale policy for the night-owl GPU pool tonight at 00:30 UTC. This is a config-only cutover (no model changes). Who can take smoke + rollback standby?

ben: I can run smoke checks. Will be online 00:20–01:00 UTC. Send the smoke commands and expected signals. :thumbsup:

carla: I can be on rollback duty if needed. What's the rollback path? How long to revert?

alice: Rollback is a single PR revert + `kubectl apply -f` to the pool-config namespace. Target recovery < 5m after revert, but give 10m for pods to drain/uptime to stabilize.

emma: Ping for the exact CLI and smoke checklist pls — I'll validate perf dashboards during smoke.

alice: Paste of the small runbook:
```
# night-owl autoscale flip smoke checklist
1) run smoke script: `./tools/smoke/gpu_pool_health.sh night-owl`
2) confirm pool size target changed: `rctl get pool night-owl -o yaml | grep minScale`
3) send load generator: `./tools/load/gen_tokens.py --pool night-owl --qps 50 --duration 120`
4) watch per-token latency on /observability/pools/night-owl (should remain < 120ms P95)
5) if errors > 1% or latency spike > 2x, stop and rollback
```

ben: Running the script locally now to sanity-check. If smoke looks good I'll post the smoke log snippet.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window for `night-owl` pool at 00:30 UTC. Owner: alice. Notify: @ben @carla @emma. (automated)

dan: Quick question — does this change adjust burst capacity or only min/max autoscale thresholds? Need to know for billing signals.

alice: Only adjusts minScale from 2 -> 4 and maxScale unchanged. Burst config untouched. Billing delta should be minimal; we'll monitor token-hours.

emma: I'll watch the console and run eval prompts after the flip (short prompt suite) — will report quality/regression within 10m.

carla: Copy. On rollback standby. If we need to revert, call me in thread and I'll execute the revert steps.

ben: smoke run complete — no errors, latency P95 held at 105ms during 2m gen. Log: `smoke_ok_3467890123.log` (uploading to #releases-artifacts). :white_check_mark:

alice: Awesome — will kick at 00:30 UTC. Plan: 00:30 apply config, 00:33 start QPS gen, 00:35 validate, 00:45 finalize. If anyone sees >1% errors or latency >240ms P95 call rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 00:30:12 UTC for night-owl autoscale-policy (cfg-2026-03-17-23).

ben: Watching — no error spikes so far.

emma: Quality checks passed (short eval suite), no regressions. :tada:

alice: Closing out — no rollback needed. Thanks all. :pray:
